Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. name: Defenders of Wildlife
subject: All Around America: Grab your binoculars and head to the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex!
body:
Celebrate America’s incredible wilderness this summer
Celebrate America’s incredible wilderness this summer
| [](https://support.defenders.org/s/5803949/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
###
North America is home to some of the most incredible landscapes on Earth – and this summer, Defenders is taking you there! Join us as we celebrate the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States by bringing you to our most incredible wildlife refuges, national forests and more, including some in your own neck of the woods!
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
[](https://support.defenders.org/s/5803950/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Let’s go to the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex!_**
Just a short drive from downtown Sacramento, you can find a massive haven for migrating birds: the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex! Starting in 1937, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service began creating this system of refuges to support migrating birds threatened by the loss of wetlands. Today, its wetlands are a vital wintering spot for waterfowl like geese, ducks, swans and many more traveling birds.
#
It’s called a “Complex” because it’s actually six distinct refuges close together. These refuges were mostly created in response to the loss of most of California’s wetlands, largely due to agriculture. Thanks to the creation of this refuge complex, birds along the Pacific Flyway can continue to find winter habitat in the Sacramento Valley!
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Meet California’s wildlife_**
Over 300 bird and mammal species can be found in the refuges, including immediately recognizable birds like herons, hawks, pelicans, swans and more! The region’s migratory bird path is definitely the major draw, and the peak birding season runs from autumn to early winter. If you’re looking to see wild wonders without wings, the Sacramento Refuge Complex is also home to familiar animals like deer, coyotes and turtles.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_What can I do there?_**
You may want to start your journey through the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex at [**the site’s Visitor Center**](https://support.defenders.org/s/5803951/38SyG9Xl) , which is open on Fridays. There you’ll find a Discovery Room and displays, as well as tips from staff on birding hot spots. The Complex also hosts vehicle tours, as well as a number of trails for hiking and bicycling. However you explore the refuge complex, you’ll want to make sure you bring your binoculars to check out birds on the move. And if you’re taking the day to spend time in nature, consider checking out one of the numerous national forests close to the refuge complex, including Mendocino National Forest to the west and Tahoe National Forest to the east!
#
|
---
| | |
---

subject: [Sign on] Law enforcement
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Team,
Most Americans want law enforcement to have the tools and information they need to keep our communities safe and do their jobs safely.
Sounds obvious right? Well, apparently not everybody thinks so. The Trump administration just proposed a new rule that would make both of these reasonable expectations impossible — and there’s a real chance it’ll go into effect unless a lot of people speak out today.
Let’s break it down:
Currently, when someone from one state decides they want to drive into another state with a machine gun, a short-barreled rifle or shotgun, a silencer, or even a grenade, they have to ask the ATF for approval.
The goal isn’t to create red tape or a burden on gun owners. It’s to ensure that state and federal law enforcement know where these dangerous weapons are and ensure that no state laws are broken.
If Donald Trump’s wishes go into effect, that will totally change.
Under Trump’s new proposal, people traveling with these deadly weapons would only need to let the ATF know they’re traveling IF it is for longer than one year. And they wouldn’t have to wait for approval from the ATF either — approval would now be automatic. For those traveling less than a year, users would not even need to provide notice.
We’ve all heard the stories of people crossing multiple state lines to shoot or kill innocent people, including the attacker at the White House Correspondents dinner. This administration should be working to prevent these attacks, not making it easier for them to happen — in Cresco and all across the country.
But it’s not too late to speak out.
**[We are asking 5,000 grassroots supporters to tell the Trump Administration that people shouldn’t be able to cross state lines wielding dangerous weapons without reasonable checks. Click here to submit your comments directly to the ATF — we even added a template letter you can copy-paste below.](https://go.giffords.org/go/68481?t=1&akid=11665%2E3935704%2EdFQpzw)**
**[SUBMIT MY COMMENTS](https://go.giffords.org/go/68454?t=2&akid=11665%2E3935704%2EdFQpzw)**

_I write to express my strong opposition to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives’ “Instate Transport and Temporary Export of National Firearms Act” notice of proposed rulemaking (RIN 1140-AA89)._
_At a time of ongoing mass shootings and increased political violence, the ATF should not be trying to skirt state laws and allow people to travel across state lines with especially deadly firearms with no notice to federal and state law enforcement. These changes would put not only communities at risk, but also endanger law enforcement—routine traffic stops could easily turn deadly. There are multiple examples of people traveling across multiple states with the goal of doing harm, and the ATF should be trying to stop this from happening, not making it easier._
_[INSERT PERSONAL REASON FOR OPPOSITION]_
_For the safety of communities and our law enforcement, I urge you to not move forward with this dangerous rule._
_Thank you,
[SIGNATURE]_

Thank you for speaking out.
— GIFFORDS

Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

name: Citizens for Amanda Pusczek
subject: They wrote AL-04 off. We’re knocking on their doors anyway.
body:
From Oneonta to Haleyville: We’re taking our movement directly to the doors.
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
If you listen to the beltway pundits and party insiders, they’ll tell you that Alabama’s 4th Congressional District is "unwinnable" for a Democrat. They look at spreadsheets and partisan leanings, throw up their hands, and decide that working families across North Alabama don’t deserve a real choice or a real voice.
****_We don't accept that. Not for one second._****
Every single community in AL-04—from our smallest rural towns to our growing cities—deserves leadership that shows up, listens, and fights for better healthcare, stronger schools, and fair wages for working people. We aren't ceding an inch of this district, and we aren't waiting for permission to fight for our home.
That’s why we are officially launching our **Mobilize the 4th Canvass Tour**. We are taking this campaign directly to the voters, door by door, street by street.
###

* **August 8:** Oneonta @ 6:00 PM
* **August 15:** Northport @ 1:00 PM
* **August 22:** Cullman @ 6:00 PM

1. **Sign up to knock doors with us:** Head over to **[www.amandaforalabama.com](https://nkkyj.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBlbHXW2Bm5gyt6pF3/1rUoy7Z0-a5X)** to register for a canvass stop near you.

Please read this entire message. It has taken me over an hour to write this as I collect my thoughts... The radical Left is attempting a hostile takeover of the great state of Texas -- and they are funding it at a level that should alarm every freedom-loving American who reads these words. The Texas Tribune just confirmed it:my far-left opponent, James Talarico, raised over $30 million in a single quarter. That's more than triple what we raised. This is not an accident. This is a coordinated, well-funded assault by the Democrat political machine -- the same machine that has been working systematically , state by state, to dismantle the constitutional republic our Founders bled to build. They have targeted Texas because they know what we know : if they flip this Senate seat, they flip the balance of power in Washington! These far-left political fanatics will spend as much as it takes. They'll flood Texas with cash to try to crush us. This is the playbook of people who do not believe in America. It is the playbook of those who hate America. Remember: They want wide-open borders. They want far-left control over our children's education. They want to pack the Supreme Court. They want Christianity gone. They want to silence dissent, crush opposition, and fundamentally transform this Nation into an unrecognizable nightmare, with malice towards every patriot who has ever stood and placed their hand over their heart... They tried to destroy me with witch hunts. They failed. They tried to stop us in the primary. They failed. They raised $30 million to bury us. They will fail again --but only if you act right now! I need you to understand this: money in politics is not just money. It is air cover. It is television ads running in Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. It is field organizers knocking on doors in precincts across this state. Every dollar they raise that we do not match is a dollar spent convincing Texans to surrender their freedoms to Washington bureaucrats and far-left globalist interests. We have raised $9 million since April. But we must raise more to stay alive. The path to victory -- the path to defending President Trump's Senate Majority and holding the line against the radical Left's agenda -- runs directly through your decision in the next few minutes. Will you stand with us? Texas has never backed down from a fight. Neither have I. And I know -- I know -- neither will you. For Texas. For freedom. For America. Dear Friends and Supporters,

I'm deeply honored that my friend, Speaker Mike Johnson has endorsed my re-election in Virginia's 5th District. As men of faith, Speaker Johnson and I share a deep belief that America is strongest when we put God, family, and country first. That conviction guides the work we do every day in Congress.

Speaker Mike Johnson wrote:
> "Congressman John McGuire is a patriot, veteran, and conservative champion who has helped deliver working families tax cuts, a secure border, American energy dominance, and renewed American strength. As a Navy SEAL, small business owner, former state legislator, and now Congressman, John has also worked tirelessly to serve our troops, veterans, and all Virginia families. I am proud to ENDORSE Congressman John McGuire in Virginia's 5th District, and look forward to working with him to defend and grow our majority and CONTINUE our American comeback!"

As a father, Navy SEAL veteran, and small business owner, I've fought for tax cuts that help working families, a secure border, more funding for rural hospitals, American energy dominance, less regulations for farmers, the Save America Act (which we've passed out of the House multiple times), and much more. I will never stop fighting for our troops, our veterans, and every Virginia family.
Thank you, Speaker Johnson. Let's grow our majority and work as a team to Save America.

God willing, after we win this primary, the real fight begins against the radical leftist democrats: the midterm election will be a clear choice between commonsense and communism. I'm ready to continue that fight alongside Speaker Johnson and our conservative majority.

Please remind friends and make a plan to vote.

The last day to vote in the Republican primary to re-elect a proven fighter, John McGuire, is Tuesday, August 4.

body:

---
Politics today is full of noise – phony deadlines, scare tactics, and cheap gimmicks.
But I want to cut through the noise for a moment.
[I’d like to tell you a quick story.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
I grew up right here in Ohio. My parents worked hard to give me a chance at the American Dream, and I know what sacrifice looks like. Every opportunity I’ve had was built on the back of that sacrifice.
---
[](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
That’s why I never forget what it means when someone like you chips in a few dollars. It isn’t “just money.” **
**It’s trust. It’s belief. It’s a vote of confidence in the movement we’re building in Ohio and beyond. **
**So whether you’ve already donated or you’re considering it today, let me say this clearly: **
**[THANK YOU, Peter!](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)**
**We’re in an extremely tough fight. And this isn’t just any race – it’s shaping up to be the most important in the country.**
**I threw my hat in the ring now because we have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to save our country. I mean that. We were[ ONE ELECTION AWAY](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._DPp_5Q) from a country you and I wouldn’t recognize anymore.**
**President Trump saved us – with the help of folks like you – from that dire outcome. With that said, he needs loyal partners at the state level to help him succeed. **
**That’s why this race means so much. **
**So if you’ve given before (even just once, even just a buck) know this: you’ve already made a difference, and I will never take your sacrifice for granted. **
**And if you haven’t given yet –[ and you’re able to spare even $1 today](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.) – I’d be honored to have you on my team.
Every single gift, no matter the size, fuels this must-win fight.

Always grateful,**Vivek Ramaswamy**

I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America."

| [ ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkb2OpDAQhJ_GZCDjP4bAwUmIbC69EDV2D1iHf4Rt7vVPzGqiTTbrrvq6pFL_eS5PcIcL22_wqM3lljMvZccNPO6QzQ5hQ7swylRLh5bJ22eN1cYqzhrU_fAQ42PohWp2rYxh4woSkD-EkIa_qFw5DONqmWG4Nk7fSXRgsudCCtENOI4SrVBK9pb2lAhak4WCuTMxZDwvKO5CF0K8pxg6E31z6L2UlAn_RdhM2JzR1BM7CGhjuQnC5vgX8YUerYPtjDXdkt_aE4Jtc11TxACtX9sUExA-1-KXHOtpkPDpG0iYuoE7rXrCp_fRl2bAJ3BbIHz6dPs4MRQMhfDJXI4wBT7W98plc2qb_rnjcFkNRNDNgzve1crPn3Bp9j8AAP__w52ULA)

Dear Patriot,
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkb2OpDAQhJ_GZCDjP4bAwUmIbC69EDV2D1iHf4Rt7vVPzGqiTTbrrvq6pFL_eS5PcIcL22_wqM3lljMvZccNPO6QzQ5hQ7swylRLh5bJ22eN1cYqzhrU_fAQ42PohWp2rYxh4woSkD-EkIa_qFw5DONqmWG4Nk7fSXRgsudCCtENOI4SrVBK9pb2lAhak4WCuTMxZDwvKO5CF0K8pxg6E31z6L2UlAn_RdhM2JzR1BM7CGhjuQnC5vgX8YUerYPtjDXdkt_aE4Jtc11TxACtX9sUExA-1-KXHOtpkPDpG0iYuoE7rXrCp_fRl2bAJ3BbIHz6dPs4MRQMhfDJXI4wBT7W98plc2qb_rnjcFkNRNDNgzve1crPn3Bp9j8AAP__w52ULA)When I started undercover investigative journalism as a college student at Rutgers, I pored over the history of journalism. I studied the techniques of great authors who broke stories that transformed America. From Stetson Kennedy, who infiltrated the highest echelons of the KKK in the 1940s, to Upton Sinclair, who went undercover in the 1900s working in a meatpacking plant in Chicago. Sinclair's book, The Jungle, resulted in a national uproar over food safety and the creation of what is now the Food and Drug Administration. Every notable author and journalist who came before me used similar tactics to get the story: fearless boots on the ground. And as I've found in my nearly 20 years as a journalist, my job is limited to what I can see and record through public access . . . undercover or not. At the end of each investigation, I'm left wanting more. I can see the threads dangling in front of me, waiting to be pulled, but accessible only to law enforcement and their powers to investigate. **But now, the world has shifted . . .** I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America." Following my opening remarks, where I expressed my limits as a journalist, something extraordinary happened. **Committee Chairman Rand Paul invited me to submit requests for subpoenas to his office.** Notably, Senator Paul, as the chairman of HSGAC, is the only member of the Senate with **unilateral authority** to issue subpoenas. From Upton Sinclair to Woodward and Bernstein, the model for action has been: **Journalist publishes → Institution reacts.** After my testimony before the Senate, that model will be inverted . . . **at least temporarily.** Power shifts. Rules change. **Doors close.** That's why we have to [**move fast**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkb2OpDAQhJ_GZCDjP4bAwUmIbC69EDV2D1iHf4Rt7vVPzGqiTTbrrvq6pFL_eS5PcIcL22_wqM3lljMvZccNPO6QzQ5hQ7swylRLh5bJ22eN1cYqzhrU_fAQ42PohWp2rYxh4woSkD-EkIa_qFw5DONqmWG4Nk7fSXRgsudCCtENOI4SrVBK9pb2lAhak4WCuTMxZDwvKO5CF0K8pxg6E31z6L2UlAn_RdhM2JzR1BM7CGhjuQnC5vgX8YUerYPtjDXdkt_aE4Jtc11TxACtX9sUExA-1-KXHOtpkPDpG0iYuoE7rXrCp_fRl2bAJ3BbIHz6dPs4MRQMhfDJXI4wBT7W98plc2qb_rnjcFkNRNDNgzve1crPn3Bp9j8AAP__w52ULA), and I need your help more than ever to take advantage of an unprecedented offer. I'm putting together a small team of researchers who can pull those dangling threads left from current and previously closed investigations.
* We can follow the money trails to see who is truly behind the fraudulent ballots.
* We have a shot at unraveling the global web of money that funds illegal immigration.
* We finally have a chance to see the documents behind Pfizer's illegal "Gain of Function" research on COVID-19.

**At the bottom of every rabbit hole is a lock box filled with receipts.** Senator Paul has handed us a golden key. [**Will you help me fund this new squad?**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkb2OpDAQhJ_GZCDjP4bAwUmIbC69EDV2D1iHf4Rt7vVPzGqiTTbrrvq6pFL_eS5PcIcL22_wqM3lljMvZccNPO6QzQ5hQ7swylRLh5bJ22eN1cYqzhrU_fAQ42PohWp2rYxh4woSkD-EkIa_qFw5DONqmWG4Nk7fSXRgsudCCtENOI4SrVBK9pb2lAhak4WCuTMxZDwvKO5CF0K8pxg6E31z6L2UlAn_RdhM2JzR1BM7CGhjuQnC5vgX8YUerYPtjDXdkt_aE4Jtc11TxACtX9sUExA-1-KXHOtpkPDpG0iYuoE7rXrCp_fRl2bAJ3BbIHz6dPs4MRQMhfDJXI4wBT7W98plc2qb_rnjcFkNRNDNgzve1crPn3Bp9j8AAP__w52ULA) Remember, Al Capone was brought down by an accountant. In today's dollars, Capone's criminal enterprise was worth $2 billion. Taxpayers are being defrauded of at least **$250 billion every year** on the federal level alone — money out of your pocket, counted against your vote. And at the Senate hearing on Fraud in America, our elected officials admitted that the governmental bodies tasked with stopping fraud for decades are wholly ineffective. That leaves us to do the job. Are you in? [**Help me and my team get to work.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkb2OpDAQhJ_GZCDjP4bAwUmIbC69EDV2D1iHf4Rt7vVPzGqiTTbrrvq6pFL_eS5PcIcL22_wqM3lljMvZccNPO6QzQ5hQ7swylRLh5bJ22eN1cYqzhrU_fAQ42PohWp2rYxh4woSkD-EkIa_qFw5DONqmWG4Nk7fSXRgsudCCtENOI4SrVBK9pb2lAhak4WCuTMxZDwvKO5CF0K8pxg6E31z6L2UlAn_RdhM2JzR1BM7CGhjuQnC5vgX8YUerYPtjDXdkt_aE4Jtc11TxACtX9sUExA-1-KXHOtpkPDpG0iYuoE7rXrCp_fRl2bAJ3BbIHz6dPs4MRQMhfDJXI4wBT7W98plc2qb_rnjcFkNRNDNgzve1crPn3Bp9j8AAP__w52ULA) We have HUNDREDS of Al Capones to take down who have been ripping all of us off and stealing our national treasure . . . and our votes. **Time is short.**[**Please help me and my team get started today.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkb2OpDAQhJ_GZCDjP4bAwUmIbC69EDV2D1iHf4Rt7vVPzGqiTTbrrvq6pFL_eS5PcIcL22_wqM3lljMvZccNPO6QzQ5hQ7swylRLh5bJ22eN1cYqzhrU_fAQ42PohWp2rYxh4woSkD-EkIa_qFw5DONqmWG4Nk7fSXRgsudCCtENOI4SrVBK9pb2lAhak4WCuTMxZDwvKO5CF0K8pxg6E31z6L2UlAn_RdhM2JzR1BM7CGhjuQnC5vgX8YUerYPtjDXdkt_aE4Jtc11TxACtX9sUExA-1-KXHOtpkPDpG0iYuoE7rXrCp_fRl2bAJ3BbIHz6dPs4MRQMhfDJXI4wBT7W98plc2qb_rnjcFkNRNDNgzve1crPn3Bp9j8AAP__w52ULA) Thank you for all that you do.
In Truth,James O'KeefeFounder, O'Keefe Media Group
P.S. I'm still grasping the impact of the Senate hearing. Most journalists might just smile and say "thank you" if Senator Paul asked them to submit subpoena requests to him. But those journalists have not gone as deep as I have. They haven't risked their lives. Some never leave the comfort of their office. I know what the offer means. I've lived with the frustration of knowing that the true players behind an operation can hide in darkness. With your help, OMG is taking advantage of this immediately — until the door closes. [**Please help fund this rapid response team today.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkb2OpDAQhJ_GZCDjP4bAwUmIbC69EDV2D1iHf4Rt7vVPzGqiTTbrrvq6pFL_eS5PcIcL22_wqM3lljMvZccNPO6QzQ5hQ7swylRLh5bJ22eN1cYqzhrU_fAQ42PohWp2rYxh4woSkD-EkIa_qFw5DONqmWG4Nk7fSXRgsudCCtENOI4SrVBK9pb2lAhak4WCuTMxZDwvKO5CF0K8pxg6E31z6L2UlAn_RdhM2JzR1BM7CGhjuQnC5vgX8YUerYPtjDXdkt_aE4Jtc11TxACtX9sUExA-1-KXHOtpkPDpG0iYuoE7rXrCp_fRl2bAJ3BbIHz6dPs4MRQMhfDJXI4wBT7W98plc2qb_rnjcFkNRNDNgzve1crPn3Bp9j8AAP__w52ULA)

And as I've found in my nearly 20 years as a journalist, my job is limited to what I can see and record through public access . . . undercover or not. At the end of each investigation, I'm left wanting more. I can see the threads dangling in front of me, waiting to be pulled, but accessible only to law enforcement and their powers to investigate. But now, the world has shifted . . . I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America." Following my opening remarks, where I expressed my limits as a journalist, something extraordinary happened. Committee Chairman Rand Paul invited me to submit requests for subpoenas to his office. Notably, Senator Paul, as the chairman of HSGAC, is the only member of the Senate with unilateral authority to issue subpoenas. From Upton Sinclair to Woodward and Bernstein, the model for action has been: Journalist publishes → Institution reacts. After my testimony before the Senate, that model will be inverted . . . at least temporarily. Power shifts. Rules change. Doors close. That's why we have to , and I need your help more than ever to take advantage of an unprecedented offer. I'm putting together a small team of researchers who can pull those dangling threads left from current and previously closed investigations. We can follow the money trails to see who is truly behind the fraudulent ballots. We have a shot at unraveling the global web of money that funds illegal immigration. We finally have a chance to see the documents behind Pfizer's illegal "Gain of Function" research on COVID-19. At the bottom of every rabbit hole is a lock box filled with receipts. Senator Paul has handed us a golden key. Remember, Al Capone was brought down by an accountant. In today's dollars, Capone's criminal enterprise was worth $2 billion. Taxpayers are being defrauded of at least $250 billion every year on the federal level alone — money out of your pocket, counted against your vote. And at the Senate hearing on Fraud in America, our elected officials admitted that the governmental bodies tasked with stopping fraud for decades are wholly ineffective. That leaves us to do the job. Are you in? We have HUNDREDS of Al Capones to take down who have been ripping all of us off and stealing our national treasure . . . and our votes. Time is short.** Thank you for all that you do. In Truth,James O'KeefeFounder, O'Keefe Media Group P.S. I'm still grasping the impact of the Senate hearing. Most journalists might just smile and say "thank you" if Senator Paul asked them to submit subpoena requests to him. But those journalists have not gone as deep as I have. They haven't risked their lives. Some never leave the comfort of their office. I know what the offer means. I've lived with the frustration of knowing that the true players behind an operation can hide in darkness. With your help, OMG is taking advantage of this immediately — until the door closes. Pop Acta Media | Conservative Innovation PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

I look at my boys and I think about the world they're going to grow up in.
I think about whether they'll be able to afford a home in the state their father chose to build his life in and whether a great public education opens doors for them. **At some point, my thoughts have to turn to actions, so I am running for Congress to make sure opportunity isn 't just reserved for the wealthy.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d43b646-4015-43d8-86c7-df0bf3823406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Today I woke up thinking about the young people across this country who are doing everything right and still can't afford rent in the cities where the jobs are, because I wouldn't want my own family in that situation. This is a generation inheriting a climate crisis they didn't create and a student loan system designed to trap them.
I think about the young women in this district and across this country who now live in a country where the government has more say over their bodies than their own doctors do.
**My sons deserve better than that world. So do yours, and the generation after that, and every single one that comes after. This is a national crisis, and it can end starting right here in TN-04.[ Chip in $20 today to keep us ahead this primary season and let's make a real difference for our families this year.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/88f13d57-26f9-4638-9789-2518256a10e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

We deserve a government that invests in their future instead of auctioning it off to the highest bidder and treats their rights as non-negotiable.
I'm not running for a title. I'm running for **them,** and I hope you'll back me up.

| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=aa8d95767c124517851cfa9a5275ac51&_e=OinLojv3aokYxwzUYrvyXx66p9DYCUJ6MhM6_K2e19YfpYhq-Uv1k2z9aV98JQUk7D-QEheMJoU2T9Bid8yysa7DsDx3U90SOTb-DyelYHifycym_bXiF6ndYqJ2054xdihkHTFMnut8SB0itHqSndMsklT28bpo7_WRNnKb1M2dEIEv6nd0G8L3jKY7yPra582ktCafQtvPQlv4DYIVm6cPOTvltRpg-AzDzF42FQaZLJeTYPqrc_kIQkPPygoDEjeJnsZhCRl-GVruD3UtwvXRQtQpsP2nr9D_RZlMtf0IrExin-lXjS_PmddcJw4zqVtctAtXm3Z5ch4bmA5inZj7waowf1G1a5627mQEjbjWU_zPa77ab7rXFLQHW-EMdf8C9j81lQR7y_R07406PCMMPyoB17mhzsF0wa27H0vQXU56nqGNKAGZsdfchzsvh_Enc2jXwWRlF3GQ2wW7Wyj6xM3xv5IqMBPefk1NleW7gWaT-e1AjfvAbVCHrHGLpFwT5BmT_oooynX9GP9QfypCRT9VRGxMihu1LhbSk9PMR9N6NoUSd8TaMoOtq8IBhnAllRQAhGmW-TABHZ78At2XnN1chL0qdosAn81JLgIKP6eKAjFQThinxiqPYHd1BV6fAdDePOzg0sT4Ts4wPioOq13BBP8Cg4ZMp-nNuKj_eVtwcZBFcEeCPRRoyGa5qLYvdCOJVohAsW02BAFu0g%3D%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=aa8d95767c124517851cfa9a5275ac51&_e=OinLojv3aokYxwzUYrvyXx66p9DYCUJ6MhM6_K2e19YfpYhq-Uv1k2z9aV98JQUk7D-QEheMJoU2T9Bid8yysa7DsDx3U90SOTb-DyelYHifycym_bXiF6ndYqJ2054xdihkHTFMnut8SB0itHqSndMsklT28bpo7_WRNnKb1M2dEIEv6nd0G8L3jKY7yPra582ktCafQtvPQlv4DYIVm6cPOTvltRpg-AzDzF42FQaZLJeTYPqrc_kIQkPPygoDuGLwXK7HCeaCY-xhXpo-BUDE0N9vYE8wPaPLxcM_SMvIpOXuE_sHmNd5zXhDsNdGvAGBLIJyquXCuYBoQDMJkEn5xrlYfUtDvDHN9lQgGkHMhzapnTGKPLIvMDwPZOPpRrbsDV3vprqY-tdYqcvs9WSqVJ1qwdsPQ6kkaGXpG8Wk0BEYus0-cRJ_L7tQH38woQhCxQQAFdmcMNovRz67-YjBYVChcGv_DvzB2r0K0JEufZSdlEMyPoJObF85XZdtoDS12ezQg91L_Md3ZhBuE8tR1fQIzpX8MI0ZojKQN1z66mL5PsTnrBTi0_jEzAIGg8y0ZVXvSoXv-6HXsouLdMNm7M68n309Ij-In7nCXxl_PY6goLH4s61FBl8VMYvIewNPN5COA4-EOtBJF8ZREQrGyu2v0XRFbGxgxlgKS97Pd9NulbqIRrSw6t5N5LDuZ_YYWgdSuh2QEHArKolYRQ%3D%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=aa8d95767c124517851cfa9a5275ac51&_e=OinLojv3aokYxwzUYrvyXx66p9DYCUJ6MhM6_K2e19YfpYhq-Uv1k2z9aV98JQUk7D-QEheMJoU2T9Bid8yysa7DsDx3U90SOTb-DyelYHifycym_bXiF6ndYqJ2054xdihkHTFMnut8SB0itHqSndMsklT28bpo7_WRNnKb1M2dEIEv6nd0G8L3jKY7yPra582ktCafQtvPQlv4DYIVm6cPOTvltRpg-AzDzF42FQaZLJeTYPqrc_kIQkPPygoDxk1Eik3DlRsrSMZzjPNSn1rz9YYhRpCWJQyjvNuS70kOqtfIrZuJAEX-0sbPDiljC6Uwo0njocPjGtS847pvhtsT5CMnwWz9-G3k9eFLn_zvjgnYbV7mPXEeIoyubrkn_3baIbyKvzIxXBqhddMM6-jWi86wttVwXwKCfiO8Hix7_437dHt2qGCBUt0d6PlYKZtPFsZulxg3bGdIDNGHstWqBzPAcfG79nMhUKTiFmRGMB1R52YXvljSlyVfqxvJ0dhkZcsCs-P9umSRrGVT46rjKY3jr3T5d7pYSMJjqudWmw58tRwKik9_fb6foz-5gckW1-qKP0Gil0wweQdvgd9oeVHRzFYIxqCSq_iKtZnbITz1_9dbD4N48RCkpfH6amh5_AJkBQK4ngK5xZ-vtvvBufRxBCXkXXNey3MZZ6o_GwRKZqeyFzvvZRbGiWvGbLdrq4n5gvrF9tedIhqo7g%3D%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. What we’re building here in Ohio is special, and even _Fox News_ can’t ignore it.
Our momentum is growing by the day – but so is the target on our backs. Republicans see that we have a clear path to victory, and they’re going to do everything in their power to stop us in our tracks. **[Before I say more, will you split $5 between my campaign and Chris Pappas now so we can hit our $200,000 rapid-response goal and take on whatever comes next?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260725_1.uVPoI2&refcode=em20260725-1&t=2&akid=7934%2E582294%2EcVCXoL)**

Now, with today’s race ratings change, the momentum continues to shift in our favor.

Look – I don’t know what’s coming next, but I do know that the only way we can keep things going in our favor is by responding quickly in moments like this and fighting hard each and every day until the election. **Ohio broke the record for the most expensive Senate race in history last time, so we need a lot of support if we’re going to pull this off.**

I had the opportunity to have a debate with liberal show host Brian Shapiro this past week and it did not take long for Shapiro to bring up January 6.
For context, I have been on Shapiro's show before and I enjoy our lively debates, but one thing I have noticed is that almost every time I have gone on his show, he inevitably brings up the riot at the Capitol building on January 6.
Shapiro vehemently disagreed when I said the Left has lost their minds over Trump's immigration policies. I pointed to examples that took place not that long ago. Shapiro then asked if I had used the same "lost their minds" term after I covered January 6. Since that was over five years ago, I said I don't believe I used the same wording, which Shapiro took as a "gotcha" moment to highlight my hypocrisy.
## WATCH:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/62c54653-a4fa-4ab7-bf76-ba101147af70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

One thing I love about liberals and progressives using January 6 as a crutch to make their arguments is that they are now using a day, which shouldn't have happened, that took place half a decade ago. As I said to Shapiro, they have only one day to go back to when talking about an example of large-scale political violence.
Meanwhile, just from President Donald Trump's second term, there have been hundreds of examples of leftists rioting and conducting attacks against federal law enforcement and buildings in response to Trump's immigration policies.
Just this week, we saw a man, who has a documented history of taking part in anti-ICE protests and engaging with leftist groups, conduct an arson attack at the federal building in New York City. The suspect left a sign that said, "ICE off our streets."

Oh, and one of the people who were injured in that attack was an immigrant who had a court appearance at the building.
Perhaps the greatest example of the Left losing their minds over Trump was when a gunman shot at an ICE office in Dallas, only for him to end up killing illegal immigrants who were in custody. No ICE agent or staff were physically harmed in the attack.
Let's not forget that anti-ICE activists have put themselves in high-stress situations by trying to track down and following ICE agents during operations.
Since I have spent the bulk of my 10-year career covering large-scale leftist violence, I can confidently say the Left has indeed lost their minds and have become more violent in response to Trump. You don't have to take my word for it, you only need to look at the copious amount of videos from the streets.

| | | | _Committee members highlighted the calendar’s ability to battle-test the field of candidates with a rigorous, fair, and efficient mix of early states._
Today, at the July meeting of the Rules and Bylaws Committee (RBC), the RBC voted to select six states for the early window of the 2028 Democratic presidential nominating calendar: South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan, and Virginia. At the meeting, the RBC voted to issue the waivers to each of the six early window states, inviting them to hold nominating contests prior to Super Tuesday in the following order:
* South Carolina, January 22, 2028
* Nevada, February 1, 2028
* New Hampshire, February 8, 2028
* New Mexico, February 15, 2028
* Michigan, February 22, 2028
* Virginia, February 29, 2028

_**RBC Co-Chairs Minyon Moore and James Roosevelt, Jr. released the following statement:**_
“The Rules and Bylaws Committee has proposed a rigorous, fair, and efficient calendar that will win Democrats back the White House in 2028. After months of hard work and deliberation, we are very proud of the calendar that the RBC has put forward — which is also the most diverse calendar Democrats have ever had for an open nominating contest. We look forward to presenting the proposal to our colleagues across the DNC for their approval in a few weeks.”
_**DNC Chair Ken Martin released the following statement:**_
“I commend the RBC for their diligent work and commitment to a fair and transparent selection process. As a result of their hard work, today, Democrats took a critical step toward retaking the White House in 2028 by ensuring we have the strongest possible nominee.”
**Additional Context on the Early Window Process:**
* During the meeting, RBC members debated the potential early window options and ultimately determined that the six states selected best fit the goals laid out by the Committee: a rigorous, fair, and efficient calendar that will produce the strongest possible nominee to win back the White House.
* The RBC also chose to amend the Committee’s previously adopted resolution on the Principles and Procedures for Review of the 2028 Democratic Party Presidential Primary Calendar. The amended resolution allowed them to select a sixth state for the early window, instead of only 4 or 5. Members explained this change was a reflection of the numerous strong applications and their goal to create the best early window possible from their available options.
* The RBC’s decision will now be put before the full DNC for a vote at the DNC’s summer meeting, August 13-15.
* The RBC’s decision comes after many months of careful planning and deliberation by the RBC, including:
* Deliberately chosen [criteria](https://us.list-manage.com/18SbiuCwhaZ?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) for selection and an open application process
* Thoughtful [consideration](https://us.list-manage.com/eWZaAkHeqZX?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) of applications and [presentations](https://us.list-manage.com/BPZats4Antm?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) by states
* Thorough [review](https://us.list-manage.com/1TbiMcyT5xt?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) of the rules for the process
* The full meeting was livestreamed and can be found on the DNC’s YouTube page [here](https://us.list-manage.com/krBaCRpiayW?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).

**Background on Selected States:**
* Battle-testing Our Candidates: The early window delivers on RBC’s goal of a battle-tested nominee both with key battleground states and tests with a comprehensive range of voters key to winning back the White House.
* Key battleground states are prominently featured in the early window with both Nevada and Michigan.
* Other early window states feature competitive downballot races and swing voter populations with New Hampshire, New Mexico, South Carolina, and Virginia.
* Comprehensive Test with Diverse Voters: The early window provides a comprehensive test with diverse groups of voters that are key to winning a general election. In fact, it is the most diverse open field early window in Democratic Party history, massively increasing diverse representation from 2020 early window states.
* **Black Voters:** [4.6 million](https://us.list-manage.com/gDkxR9Rf_Vv?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) Black people live in the early window states, an increase of 2.8 million.
* **Latino Voters:** [4.2 million](https://us.list-manage.com/1BkaamvPP3m?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) Latinos live in the early window states, an increase of 2.4 million.
* **AANHPI Voters:** [1.4 million](https://us.list-manage.com/Hncg3jaMjcQ?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and [Pacific Islander](https://us.list-manage.com/7ihYIe46oHK?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) Americans live in the early window states, an increase of 900k.
* **Native American Voters:** [370k](https://us.list-manage.com/tJuZZIFmpY2?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) Native Americans live in the early window states, an increase of 280k.
* **Non-college Voters:** [14 million](https://us.list-manage.com/2tmObJqMq2t?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) Americans in the early window states do not have a college degree, an increase of 7.7 million.
* **Young Voters:** More than [2.8 million](https://us.list-manage.com/10YW1UYvVCC?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) young (18-24) people live in the early window states, an increase of more than 1.6 million.
* **Union Voters:** More than [1.1 million](https://us.list-manage.com/51X29hIOABA?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) union workers live in the early window states, an increase of more than 700k.
* **Veterans/Military Voters:** More than 2.1 million [veteran](https://us.list-manage.com/10hXBd6WiB9?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) and [military](https://us.list-manage.com/YZGiUIAr9wD?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) voters live in the early window states, an increase of more than 1.2 million.
* Keeping the Contest Open, Affordable: The early window is open and affordable for candidates — ensuring voters choose our 2028 nominee, not money.
* The earliest portion of the window creates an open field, and does not box out any candidates based solely on warchest and name ID.
* South Carolina has a very affordable media market, with estimated weekly ad cost that is among the [lowest](https://us.list-manage.com/LI_jAxKB1i4?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) of any of the early states.
* The relatively inexpensive Reno media market serves the vast majority of Nevadans outside of the Las Vegas media market.
* Both South Carolina and New Hampshire are geographically compact states, making travel more affordable and accessible.

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2579%2E5691347%2E26MNPK)

This week, Trump came to Georgia to mobilize Republicans to flip Jon’s seat and elect a MAGA puppet to the Senate.
This will not be the last time Trump tries to meddle in Georgia’s U.S. Senate race because Donald Trump is focused on electing his lackey, Mike Collins, and locking in a Republican Senate majority for the long term. [**If you are ready to stand up to Trump and help Jon win in November, you can chip in $5 here:**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260725-1-subs&utm_campaign=em260725-1-subs&t=2&akid=2579%2E5691347%2E26MNPK)
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260725-1-subs&utm_campaign=em260725-1-subs&t=3&akid=2579%2E5691347%2E26MNPK)**
Peter, Trump’s support is SO dangerous because it comes with hundreds of millions of dollars. See this new reporting from the _Financial Times_ :
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-july26.OmRLd4&refcode=em260725-1-subs&t=4&akid=2579%2E5691347%2E26MNPK)
Not only is Trump mobilizing his right-wing base in Georgia, but Peter, Trump’s presence here signals MAGA donors and Super PACs to turn their deep pockets to this Senate race.
With a single MAGA Super PAC boasting more than **_$400 MILLION_** to spend in the midterms, and with Trump heavily invested in Republicans winning in Georgia, it is more critical than ever that Jon has the resources he needs to fight back against the attacks headed his way.
Jon can win in November, but he can’t do it alone. He needs all of us to have his back against whatever Trump and Republicans will throw at him.
[**Peter, can Jon count on you today? Give $5, $10, or whatever you can spare to make sure Jon has the resources he needs to fight back against MAGA. It’s one step you can take right now to make a real difference in this race.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260725-1-subs&utm_campaign=em260725-1-subs&t=5&akid=2579%2E5691347%2E26MNPK)

body:
This is the moment, and I need you in it with us. Here’s our plan:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260725-1&t=1&akid=3774%2E587540%2EKYah6_)
Peter,
I’m going to be straight with you.
The moment we’re in right now is unlike anything Leaders We Deserve has faced since we started our mission.
The Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Trump is waging an illegal war in Iran. Healthcare is out of reach for millions of people. Corporate landlords are gobbling up homes and pricing working families out of their neighborhoods. And many leaders in the Democratic Party are still figuring out if they’re willing to fight back with more than just a strongly worded letter.
Honestly, we don't have the luxury to wait around for the rest of the Party to wake up. We have to start moving on the issues that matter to us most and electing the leaders who will get us there right now.
That’s why this is our biggest year yet. We’ll be backing the largest slate of candidates we’ve ever had. There are more races to fight ahead, and more opportunities to prove that bold, people-powered politics can win anywhere in this country.
The House majority is within reach. State legislatures are flippable. And what we do between now and November will determine whether we rise to meet this moment or let it slip through our fingers.
So here’s our plan for this cycle:
* **Back the boldest, most fearless progressive candidates running for state legislatures and Congress across the country.** People who come from the communities they’re fighting for, refuse corporate PAC money, and have the courage to do what’s right instead of what’s safe.
* **Challenge asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats in safe blue seats who are failing to meet this moment in order to strengthen our Party.** Voters deserve a Party that actually holds its leaders accountable and is willing to respond to the urgency of this moment with the moral clarity and vision for the future that it demands.

This plan works. We’ve already proven that, and taken home meaningful wins this cycle. But none of this work happens without resources. We don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or special interests. We don’t have the establishment funding machine behind us, or self interested mega donors writing us checks. We have you, and tens of thousands of people like you who truly believe in what we’re building.
So here’s what I’m asking, Peter:
**[If you’re in a position to give big — $500, $1,000, or more — now is the moment.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5748?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260725_1_tierask.IVDfFj&refcode=em20260725-3774&t=2&akid=3774%2E587540%2EKYah6_)** Your support doesn’t just fund one candidate, it funds the infrastructure that finds them, supports their campaigns on a daily basis, and gets them across the finish line.
**[If you can give a little every month — $5, $25, $50 — we need you standing with us.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2774?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260725_1_tierask.fEyz4i&refcode=em20260725-3774&amount=5&t=3&akid=3774%2E587540%2EKYah6_)** Recurring donors are at the backbone of what we do. They’re the reason we can plan ahead, invest early, and show up for candidates when it counts the most.
**[If you can only give once — whatever you can afford — we appreciate that deeply.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260725_1_tierask.0EJUaG&refcode=em20260725-3774&amount=5&t=4&akid=3774%2E587540%2EKYah6_)** Every dollar is proof that this isn’t a movement bought and paid for by corporate PACs or special interests. It’s a people-powered movement, ready to win.
**And if you can’t give anything right now** — _that’s okay._ Not everyone is in a position to contribute money, and I completely understand that. What I’m asking for instead: Forward this email. Share what we’re doing on your social media. Talk to a friend or family member about Justin J. Pearson, Ruwa Romman, Christian Menefee, or any of the incredible candidates we’re backing this cycle. Bring someone else along with you in this fight.
This is the moment. And we need you in it. Whatever you’re able to contribute today, please know that it truly makes a difference. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for showing up for this movement. I’m grateful to be doing this work alongside you.

With gratitude,
David Hogg

The moment we’re in right now is unlike anything Leaders We Deserve has faced since we started our mission. The Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Trump is waging an illegal war in Iran. Healthcare is out of reach for millions of people. Corporate landlords are gobbling up homes and pricing working families out of their neighborhoods. And many leaders in the Democratic Party are still figuring out if they’re willing to fight back with more than just a strongly worded letter. Honestly, we don't have the luxury to wait around for the rest of the Party to wake up. We have to start moving on the issues that matter to us most and electing the leaders who will get us there right now. That’s why this is our biggest year yet. We’ll be backing the largest slate of candidates we’ve ever had. There are more races to fight ahead, and more opportunities to prove that bold, people-powered politics can win anywhere in this country. The House majority is within reach. State legislatures are flippable. And what we do between now and November will determine whether we rise to meet this moment or let it slip through our fingers. So here’s our plan for this cycle: Back the boldest, most fearless progressive candidates running for state legislatures and Congress across the country. People who come from the communities they’re fighting for, refuse corporate PAC money, and have the courage to do what’s right instead of what’s safe. Challenge asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats in safe blue seats who are failing to meet this moment in order to strengthen our Party. Voters deserve a Party that actually holds its leaders accountable and is willing to respond to the urgency of this moment with the moral clarity and vision for the future that it demands. This plan works. We’ve already proven that, and taken home meaningful wins this cycle. But none of this work happens without resources. We don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or special interests. We don’t have the establishment funding machine behind us, or self interested mega donors writing us checks. We have you, and tens of thousands of people like you who truly believe in what we’re building. So here’s what I’m asking, Peter: Your support doesn’t just fund one candidate, it funds the infrastructure that finds them, supports their campaigns on a daily basis, and gets them across the finish line. Recurring donors are at the backbone of what we do. They’re the reason we can plan ahead, invest early, and show up for candidates when it counts the most. Every dollar is proof that this isn’t a movement bought and paid for by corporate PACs or special interests. It’s a people-powered movement, ready to win. And if you can’t give anything right now — that’s okay. Not everyone is in a position to contribute money, and I completely understand that. What I’m asking for instead: Forward this email. Share what we’re doing on your social media. Talk to a friend or family member about Justin J. Pearson, Ruwa Romman, Christian Menefee, or any of the incredible candidates we’re backing this cycle. Bring someone else along with you in this fight. This is the moment. And we need you in it. Whatever you’re able to contribute today, please know that it truly makes a difference. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for showing up for this movement. I’m grateful to be doing this work alongside you. With gratitude, David Hogg Leaders We Deserve

name: Melanie Lucero For Congress
subject: America First isn't a slogan. It's an audit.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY MELANIE LUCERO FOR CONGRESS
body:
"We're getting touchdowns every day." Really? What field are you playing on?
| [ MELANIE LUCERO
FOR CONGRESS · VIRGINIA'S 5TH DISTRICT ](https://us.list-manage.com/EpJl0lJ7OQ_?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Where I stand · America First
# America First isn't a slogan. It's an audit — and a fight.
Peter,Let me ask you something. When a career politician stands up, rattles off the awards he's received, and tells you "we're getting touchdowns every day" — what's your gut reaction?Mine is a question: **what field are you playing on?** Because on the field where the rest of us live — the grocery store, the gas pump, the VA waiting room — nobody's seen those touchdowns.Here's what _is_ happening while they give that same speech over and over: the federal government loses up to **$521 billion every single year to fraud**. That's not my number — it's the Government Accountability Office's. That's enough to fund the entire United States Marine Corps ten times over, torched every year on waste, fraud, abuse, and programs no one can defend with a straight face.That's what America First means in my campaign. Not a slogan — an audit. Find the waste, name it, and kill it.It also means the SAVE Act — requiring proof of citizenship to vote in our elections. Over 80% of Americans support it. And yes, my opponent voted for it. But pressing a green button on a bill that 80% of the country already wants isn't a touchdown — it's kneeling on the ball. You can't just vote for the SAVE Act. You have to **fight** for it: pull everyone possible together, build the pressure, and get it signed into law — because it's right for our country, not because it polls well for someone's career. A placeholder records a vote. A fighter delivers a law.We're in unconventional times. The old politics — "be nice, stay quiet, let them attack us" — is losing us the battlefield. Anyone can see it: we need fighters on the floor, giving the other side hell and taking ground, not placeholders reading the same safe speech for the cameras.And here's the good news: it's already happening. All across America, voters are replacing establishment-backed puppets with real people — Marines, nurses, builders, moms — who fight for the people they represent instead of toeing the party line. On August 4, the 5th District gets its turn. | [See The America First Plan](https://us.list-manage.com/11Dir8wAojL?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Takes two minutes. No forms, no pop-ups — just where I stand.
* * *
For the 5th,
Melanie Lucero
Marine Veteran · Republican for Congress, VA-05
**P.S.** The final push starts now. If you can knock doors, plant a yard sign, or make calls before August 4, [join the team here](https://us.list-manage.com/b3HhzZKSIgm?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04) — even one hour matters.

body:
Winning back trust starts with supporting leaders who understand their communities.
#
Peter,
Winning back trust in small towns and rural communities starts with putting the right people on the ballot. That’s why we’re so proud to support the first three candidates on Small Town PAC’s 2026 endorsement slate.

| Letter from the Chair
---
This is the fight for Nebraska. Show up.
The Democrat Socialists of America (DSA) has laid out its platform in black and white, and it should shock every Nebraskan who cares about this state. Abolish ICE. Strip away police immunity. End the "U.S. war machine" aka our military. Lift sanctions on hostile regimes. A Green New Deal that would gut our energy and ag economy, plus "economic democracy" that hands government and union bosses control over Nebraska businesses. This isn't some far-off national fight, it's the agenda DSA-aligned candidates are quietly running on right here, from school boards to Congress.
What does "Democracy" mean to DSA? The US is founded upon a Constitutional Republic form of government and not a democracy for a reason. Democracies result in tyranny of the majority and no consideration of the minority. A Constitutional Republic has checks and balances to prevent both tyranny of the majority and tyranny of the minority.
And ask them directly, they'll point to Norway, Sweden, and Denmark as the model.
What they won't tell you is the bill: Sweden's top tax rate hits roughly 52%, starting around $58,000 a year, not just on millionaires. Denmark's is nearly 56% and heading past 60% in 2026. All of them charge a 25% national sales tax on almost everything you buy. Total tax collection there runs 40-45% of the economy, nearly double the U.S. rate. That's the real cost of "free" everything, and it lands on the middle class, not the activists writing the platform.
Read more about the DSA platform below or click here: [https://program.dsausa.org/](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SmHeS4LDV3q6Sldzn4jbQPhuXMIZ5uqDMcFCQnVjB9KTiSYxykjEzfpfw5dPx2gwNBnA-13MuXgZA-i0ZPbx22tC_oN5Shse1MBd0NhwkiQDEh_b8p7Mqi8xF7AOyU5YQUJdpsi6UbtU9m4O_x0F927eGz1N7NSd&c=SJysyqY8w97qmVBvlT5PQYNTNxa3aHyLLtCCp9rUkEZi2UJo_j5TMA==&ch=0MlXt9oS2dV7Kc5aFdTkX9tiHjAJp3EvkEzgScNHb4QirFyI4H6F5g==)

| Nebraska values mean backing the badge, a strong national defense, and an economy built on energy, agriculture, and hard work -- not one strangled by socialist mandates and European-style taxation dressed up as "reform." Every plank of this platform asks Nebraskans to trade what built this state for a program that taxes working families harder to pay for it. Saving Nebraska doesn't happen by accident -- it happens because Republicans out-organize, out-work, and out-vote the other side, election after election. That starts now.
Make your plan to vote today. Your silence implies consent to this radical agenda. The General Election is November 3, 2026. Mail ballot applications for the general election open July 6, early voting starts October 5, and registration closes October 16 -- don't let the deadline find you unprepared. Go to vote.ne.gop right now: verify your registration, request your mail ballot, or find your polling location in under three minutes.
Then don't stop there. Talk to your neighbors. Bring three people with you when you vote. This is not a spectator fight, and Nebraska is not up for grabs. Make your plan. Vote Republican. Save Nebraska.
Together, We Win!
In Liberty and in Truth,
Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair This is the fight for Nebraska. Show up. The Democrat Socialists of America (DSA) has laid out its platform in black and white, and it should shock every Nebraskan who cares about this state. Abolish ICE. Strip away police immunity. End the "U.S. war machine" aka our military. Lift sanctions on hostile regimes. A Green New Deal that would gut our energy and ag economy, plus "economic democracy" that hands government and union bosses control over Nebraska businesses. This isn't some far-off national fight, it's the agenda DSA-aligned candidates are quietly running on right here, from school boards to Congress. What does "Democracy" mean to DSA? The US is founded upon a Constitutional Republic form of government and not a democracy for a reason. Democracies result in tyranny of the majority and no consideration of the minority. A Constitutional Republic has checks and balances to prevent both tyranny of the majority and tyranny of the minority. And ask them directly, they'll point to Norway, Sweden, and Denmark as the model. What they won't tell you is the bill: Sweden's top tax rate hits roughly 52%, starting around $58,000 a year, not just on millionaires. Denmark's is nearly 56% and heading past 60% in 2026. All of them charge a 25% national sales tax on almost everything you buy. Total tax collection there runs 40-45% of the economy, nearly double the U.S. rate. That's the real cost of "free" everything, and it lands on the middle class, not the activists writing the platform. Read more about the DSA platform below or click here: == | | == | Nebraska values mean backing the badge, a strong national defense, and an economy built on energy, agriculture, and hard work -- not one strangled by socialist mandates and European-style taxation dressed up as "reform." Every plank of this platform asks Nebraskans to trade what built this state for a program that taxes working families harder to pay for it. Saving Nebraska doesn't happen by accident -- it happens because Republicans out-organize, out-work, and out-vote the other side, election after election. That starts now. Make your plan to vote today. Your silence implies consent to this radical agenda. The General Election is November 3, 2026. Mail ballot applications for the general election open July 6, early voting starts October 5, and registration closes October 16 -- don't let the deadline find you unprepared. Go to vote.ne.gop right now: verify your registration, request your mail ballot, or find your polling location in under three minutes. Then don't stop there. Talk to your neighbors. Bring three people with you when you vote. This is not a spectator fight, and Nebraska is not up for grabs. Make your plan. Vote Republican. Save Nebraska. Together, We Win! In Liberty and in Truth, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party Follow us: == | ==| ==| == Donate today: Support the NEGOP at == For more information, visit == | | | From the campaign of Congressman Mike Flood... Last week, I hosted Republican candidates and campaign leaders from across Nebraska's First Congressional District to sit down together and map out how we can work together and win in November. This election is going to take hard work from all of us. National Democrats are ready to pour big money into Nebraska. But after meeting with our fantastic Republican slate of candidates, I'm confident that we will outwork the Democrats' dark money. Up and down the ballot, Republicans have a great team running this November. From the Unicameral to the top of the ticket, Republicans are united and ready to fight together for lower taxes, a stronger economy, and safer communities. Now, we need to get the word out to Nebraskans who share our conservative priorities that voting in November means continuing our work to cut taxes, protect our conservative values, and keep our country and Nebraska safe. From distributing yard signs to knocking on doors and making phone calls, I'm looking forward to our Republican Team working together to win in November. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

While families in Detroit are struggling to keep up with rising costs,
their multimillionaire congressman has been busy gambling with his
campaign funds.

Do-Nothing Democratic incumbent Rep. Shri Thanedar has lost over $600,000
in campaign money on a disastrous $3.7 million crypto investment.

Now, he’s relying on AIPAC’s billionaire and Republican megadonors to bail
him out:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260725-1-dm.hJINTC&refcode=em20260725-38077&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38077%2E1203867%2EmGf1OX ]Headline from The Intercept: "Two-thirds of Shri Thanedar's campaign
cash came through AIPAC as he lost over $600K; AIPAC bundlers have propped
up the Michigan congressman, who has invested millions in campaign funds
in crypto."

AIPAC donors are funneling massive amounts of cash to save Shri’s failing
campaign. According to The Intercept, “Two-thirds of the money Thanedar
raised in the last quarter came from AIPAC.”

He didn’t always have their support. When Shri first ran for Congress,
AIPAC opposed him because he called Israel an “apartheid state” in the
Michigan legislature. But once he got to Washington, he sold out.

In 2023, Shri went on an AIPAC-sponsored trip to Israel and quickly
changed his tune. The following year, AIPAC officially endorsed him, and
he received over $2 million in support from their right-wing
megadonor-funded network.

Like our communications director Usamah Andrabi told The Intercept, Shri’s
time in Congress is “representation for the 1% at the expense of one of
the poorest districts in the country.”

Detroit deserves better,
Peter. They deserve Justice
Democrat Donavan McKinney.

We have just 10 days left until the Michigan primary election on August
4th. Donavan has the momentum, but Shri is using his personal fortune and
checks from AIPAC’s donors to try and drown us out.

subject: I’m done hearing this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2970%2E4032634%2EjnN73D)
---
I’ll cut to the chase: [**I’m asking if you can please pitch in to support our campaign so I can keep fighting for working families in the Senate.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3715?t=8&akid=2970%2E4032634%2EjnN73D) We’re up against powerful special interests who don’t want to see our plans become a reality. We keep hearing from pundits and talking heads trying to figure out just what exactly the Democratic Party is all about — suggesting that we need to water down our economic agenda and not be “too progressive” or “too radical” in order to win. But here’s the reality: The bold, progressive candidates who campaign on a real affordability agenda are winning. It’s not radical to fight for universal childcare. It’s not radical to reject the money (and the demands) from corporate PACs. It’s not radical to call for a wealth tax. It’s not radical to campaign for Medicare for All. It’s not radical to make housing affordable. In fact, these things are the reason why we have government in the first place — to make life better for the people we serve. So I’m done hearing that Democrats need to tone down on our ambitions in order to win elections. That doesn’t make any sense. **The path forward for the Democratic party is clear: We win when we fight like hell for working people. When we champion bold ideas even if billionaires don’t like them. When we aspire to govern in ways that may not have been tried before, rather than settle with “that’s never going to happen.” When we actually stand up to the extremism of Donald Trump’s administration.** [**I’m relying on your support to help show how many people DO believe in the “radical” plans that we’re fighting for. And, your donation will help ensure we can advocate and grow momentum for our vision all across the country. So could you please pitch in $28 or anything you can? Thank you.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3715?amount=28&t=9&akid=2970%2E4032634%2EjnN73D)

name: James Carville
subject: Democrats have needed this for a long time.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve spent nearly half a century helping Democrats win elections, and I’m gonna tell you something plainly:
For too long, we have waited until the house was already on fire before deciding to buy a hose.
We wait until a race becomes a crisis.
We wait until a great candidate is getting buried in attack ads.
We wait until Republicans have already built the infrastructure, raised the money, and defined the battlefield.
Then everybody starts running around asking what happened.
Well, Raja Krishnamoorthi has gone and done something about it.
He founded Equal Opportunity Now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email] to find and support bold leaders and important causes before it’s too late — leaders who will stand up to Donald Trump and the MAGA movement, fight for working families, and actually deliver results.
And all I can say is:
FINALLY.
Finally, an organization that understands we cannot defeat MAGA with timid candidates, stale talking points, and a last-minute panic.
But Raja cannot build this by himself.
Will you contribute $25, $50, or whatever you can today to help Equal Opportunity Now find, fund, and support the leaders Democrats need to start winning again? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
SUPPORT EQUAL OPPORTUNITY NOW! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Now, I know Raja.
He is smart. He is tough. And he knows firsthand what opportunity can mean.
His family came to this country with very little. They relied on public housing and food stamps. He worked his way from Peoria all the way to Congress.
And instead of pulling the ladder up behind him, Raja has spent his career fighting to make sure the next family gets the same shot.
That means standing up for workers.
Holding powerful corporations and corrupt politicians accountable.
Defending immigrants, voting rights, and every American targeted by Trump’s politics of division.
And now he is putting that experience toward building the next generation of Democratic leadership.
Here’s the truth: The leaders we need are already out there.
They are running for city council, state legislature, Congress, and offices most national donors are not paying attention to yet.
They have the courage.
They have the ideas.
What they do not always have is the money, infrastructure, and early support necessary to compete.
That is where Equal Opportunity Now comes in.
Please chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can today to help Raja build the organization Democrats should have built years ago. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
HELP DEMOCRATS WIN: DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
We’ve got a good battle plan, now, let’s help Raja build this damn thing.
-- James Carville
Visit Our Website To Learn More! [https://www.equalopportunitynow.org/]

Schaumburg, IL 60168

These far-right politicians expect me to run away from my record throughout this campaign. To distance myself from everything we’ve accomplished together over the last four years.
Well Derek, they couldn’t be more wrong. I’m proudly running for reelection _on_ my record of standing up and delivering for all Pennsylvanians.
**Cutting taxes ten times?****__**_I’m proud we put more money back in folks’ pockets._
**Delivering over 224 million free school breakfast meals?** _A no-brainer._
**Slashing red tape and making our government work for people?** _You’re damn right._
**Protecting reproductive freedom and voting rights?**_Without question._

subject: Why I was fired:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RESIST RECLAIM REBUILD PAC (WWW
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and started working for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we needed diapers and health insurance for our growing family.
Working at Kellogg’s used to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that lets you become a homeowner, live decently, and hopefully retire someday.
But over the years, that changed. Workers were paid less. Cost-of-living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans were gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/120031/images/Screen%20Shot%202026-04-24%20at%2011.20.44%20AM.png]
Most of us had never walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines through the dead of winter if we had to. We were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks in the cold, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying union jobs.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
Following the strike, I was fired. Someone had to pay – and as union president, my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
Instead, I decided last year to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and we nearly won. I got 47% of the vote in one of the closest Senate races in the country.
Now, I’m running again for the U.S. Senate – this time against billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts – and the first poll shows us virtually TIED: 46% to 45%.
I am taking on a literal billionaire senator. We can finish what we started last year and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat for working-class people, but I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win.
Please, will you contribute to my campaign for U.S. Senate to help me defeat billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts here and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
DONATE TODAY TO DEFEAT THE MAGA BILLIONAIRES! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
I believe we can win this race and keep up the fight for the American middle class. But I’m counting on your support now to win.
Thank you,
Dan Osborn
