---

Gretchen.
Jim.
Gary.
Debbie.
When I started this race, I was hoping for endorsements. But I've been beyond humbled and honored to see so many folks I've worked with step up to say:_I 'm with Haley._
I'm so proud to **[watch this list on my website](https://substack.com/redirect/40acd5ac-37a0-4de5-924a-b493ddf21fc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** grow from a few colleagues in Congress to where it is now.
But the one endorsement I'm missing is the one I want most: yours.
Before you wave me off and say, "Haley, you've got Gov. Gretchen Whitmer and Jim Clyburn, what do you need me for?" Give me a second to explain why your endorsement truly matters.
I'm doing this for you.
At the end of the day, I'm not in this race for endorsements. I'm in this race to fight for working families.
The primary is only 10 days away, and I'm not good at B.S., so I'm going to be direct: **[Will you endorse me right now?](https://substack.com/redirect/417d2a38-bc45-414f-a9e6-b4ac0e050d41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ ENDORSE HALEY](https://substack.com/redirect/417d2a38-bc45-414f-a9e6-b4ac0e050d41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Here's some of the company you'll be joining, and why it matters:
**Governor Gretchen Whitmer** -- if there's anyone who knows what it means to be a champion for Michiganders - and what it takes to win in this tough battleground state - it's Governor Whitmer.
**Congressman Jim Clyburn and members of the Congressional Black Caucus know what delivering results looks like** -- they cited my record fighting for Michigan's Black community and my work on the auto rescue when they endorsed. The Michigan Democratic Party Black Caucus pointed to economic justice and expanding homeownership. These endorsements aren't a formality to me. They are an assignment. They're a vote of confidence, but also a charge to keep earning it. I don't take that lightly.
**Senator Gary Peters and Senator Debbie Stabenow know what this job takes** -- because between them, they've done it for decades. When the people who have actually held this seat and done the job pick me, they're saying something no political analyst can: Haley is ready to get to work on Day 1.
**Nineteen unions** -- Teamsters, IronWorkers, the trades. Union folks don't endorse you because you're good at Tik Tok. They endorse you because you've been in their halls, on their picket lines, and had their backs when it counted.
**EMILY 's List** -- reproductive freedom is on the ballot in this race, full stop, and they back candidates who fight for it and win.
Each of those endorsements says something specific. But the more important thing is what they say together: **We can win this race. We have broad support. We will keep Michigan blue.**
But still, none of these endorsements are you. Your story matters, your perspective matters, and you deserve to have someone in your corner in the U.S. Senate. I'm thinking about the small-business owners I met in Kalamazoo, the nurse in Marquette, the retiree in Monroe, and the line worker in Flint.
Because when a congressperson endorses me, that's fantastic. I'm honored. But they're public political figures; we expect them to make endorsements. When _you_ endorse me, that's the thing I'm actually running for - regular working folks who want someone to fight for them.
Back in June, I asked this grassroots team to step up and endorse my campaign, and thousands of you did. Grocery clerks. Teachers. Truck drivers. Working parents. Students. I looked at every single one of those names, and I'm telling you, I was jazzed. I still am.
Yes, having Gretchen Whitmer and Jim Clyburn's endorsement are a dream. But yours are the ones that keep me going at hour fourteen of a long day.
So with the primary just days away and Michiganders already voting, we need to show the strength of this movement. I need you, friend.
**[I'm personally asking: Will you](https://substack.com/redirect/83621f0e-e13a-48be-a9a4-5794b1a923d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)[ officially endorse my campaign today?](https://substack.com/redirect/417d2a38-bc45-414f-a9e6-b4ac0e050d41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ENDORSE HALEY](https://substack.com/redirect/417d2a38-bc45-414f-a9e6-b4ac0e050d41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And if you already added your name in June - THANK YOU. I'm glad you're on this team. Yeah, there are famous names on the list, but so is yours. That's the point.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

When you endorse me, that's the thing I'm actually running for - regular working folks who want someone to fight for them. Back in June, I asked this grassroots team to step up and endorse my campaign, and thousands of you did. Grocery clerks. Teachers. Truck drivers. Working parents. Students. I looked at every single one of those names, and I'm telling you, I was jazzed. I still am. Yes, having Gretchen Whitmer and Jim Clyburn's endorsement are a dream. But yours are the ones that keep me going at hour fourteen of a long day. So with the primary just days away and Michiganders already voting, we need to show the strength of this movement. I need you, friend. And if you already added your name in June - THANK YOU. I'm glad you're on this team. Yeah, there are famous names on the list, but so is yours. That's the point. With grit and gratitude, Haley A personal note from Haley 👋 I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love. But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican. I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win. If you're with me, will you chip in today? | | | (C) 2026 Haley for MI 33717 Woodward Ave #539, Birmingham, MI 48009 ? ?

subject: I'm proud to be Mainers’ choice for Democratic nominee in our U.S. Senate race
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HICKENLOOPER FOR COLORADO
body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135993790/635989470/106354774?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_072526_jackson&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMmI4NDg2Yi02Mzg4LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AfNl2rih6nEqkO66Js152ybT_uHD7SKGm6yMG37frLg=) Mainers have spoken: I am incredibly proud to be their choice for Democratic nominee in our U.S. Senate race. My name is Troy Jackson. Growing up in Allagash, I didn’t think I’d ever be anything other than a fifth-generation logger. And for a long time, that was more than enough. But then I got a political education. Not in some Ivy League university — when I was working in the North Woods, grinding out 80-hour workweeks under the thumb of a billionaire. In those woods I discovered the truth: working class people in this country aren’t struggling to get by because we’re not trying hard enough, or not smart enough, or not _anything_ enough. **We’re getting crushed by a rigged system, and we have been for way too long.** I got into politics after a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages. I stayed because once I was there, it was clear that _nobody_ in power understood the actual hardships I’d been living my whole life. Working class people deserve to have someone who lives these struggles in rooms where decisions are being made. Since then I’ve fought to lower the cost of prescription drugs, pass universal school meals, expand rural healthcare, protect abortion rights, and deliver tax relief. And we’ve won a lot of those fights. clean_body: = Mainers have spoken: I am incredibly proud to be their choice for Democratic nominee in our U.S. Senate race. My name is Troy Jackson. Growing up in Allagash, I didn’t think I’d ever be anything other than a fifth-generation logger. And for a long time, that was more than enough. But then I got a political education. Not in some Ivy League university — when I was working in the North Woods, grinding out 80-hour workweeks under the thumb of a billionaire. In those woods I discovered the truth: working class people in this country aren’t struggling to get by because we’re not trying hard enough, or not smart enough, or not anything enough. We’re getting crushed by a rigged system, and we have been for way too long. I got into politics after a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages. I stayed because once I was there, it was clear that nobody in power understood the actual hardships I’d been living my whole life. Working class people deserve to have someone who lives these struggles in rooms where decisions are being made. Since then I’ve fought to lower the cost of prescription drugs, pass universal school meals, expand rural healthcare, protect abortion rights, and deliver tax relief. # The Final Countdown
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/5TrocsVpf7w?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
| |
Hi friends,
This is it.
Ten days.
After seven months, thousands of conversations, hundreds of volunteers, countless cups of coffee, and more miles than I can count, we’re down to the final stretch.
I have one last fundraising goal.
We’re **572 people giving $10** away from fully funding the rest of this campaign.
(For those who love math, that’s $5,720.)
It’s kind of a weird number, and that’s intentional.
I’ve never wanted to ask for more than we actually need. Every dollar we’ve raised has had a purpose. Every expense has been planned. If you trust me with your hard-earned money, I have a responsibility to spend it wisely. I take that seriously.
I’ve also said since day one that who a candidate takes money from says a lot about who they’ll work for.
I don’t take corporate PAC money.
I don’t take Dominion money.
I don’t want wealthy donors swooping in at the last minute to write five-figure checks.
I have you.
People who believe government should belong to the people again.
People who are tired of politics feeling like something only the rich get to influence.
The truth is, these last ten days are when campaigns like mine either break through or get buried. This is when outside groups start spending. This is when the establishment doubles down.
But here’s what I also know.
I’ve watched this campaign do impossible things for seven months.
I’ve watched people knock on doors in the rain.
I’ve watched volunteers spend their weekends making calls instead of relaxing.
I’ve watched parents bring their kids to campaign events because they wanted them to see what democracy looks like.
I’ve watched complete strangers become family.
So I’m asking again, and I’ll have to ask until we reach the number we need. (I’d love to not put my family into more debt).
If you can spare $10 it will be well spent 💙
If everyone who believes in this campaign gives just $10, we’ll hit our goal and spend the next ten days doing exactly what we’ve always done: talking to voters.
No gimmicks.
No corporate money.
Just people.
Thank you for believing in me. Thank you for believing this campaign was worth building. And thank you for proving, every single day, that ordinary people still have extraordinary power.
Let’s go win this thing.
Elizabeth

---

I want to show you exactly what corruption looks like — and then I want to ask you to do something about it.
But, if you already agree that Washington corruption needs to stop, chip in to Equal Opportunity Now today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Chip In To Equal Opportunity Now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Now let me tell you why I'm so fired up.
In his first year back in office, Donald Trump personally raked in more than $2 billion while working families struggle to keep up with rising prices.
More than $1.4 billion of it came from a crypto memecoin he launched days before his inauguration, and a venture called World Liberty Financial run by his own sons. He turned the office of the President of the United States into a personal ATM, and he didn't even try to hide it.
And it gets worse.
Just weeks ago, we learned that Trump and his Commerce Secretary negotiated a deal handing an American company access to one of the largest untapped tungsten reserves on earth — in Kazakhstan. The administration approved as much as $1.6 billion in federal financing to make it happen. Your tax dollars.
And then? Within weeks of the negotiations, a firm partly owned by Don Jr. and Eric Trump took a 20% stake in a company tied to that very same project.
Let me put that plainly: the President used your money to enrich his own sons. While more than 2 million Americans lost their health coverage. While hospitals and nursing homes were being defunded. While working families were told there just wasn't enough to go around.
There was plenty to go around. It just went to the Trumps.
This is the most corrupt administration in American history. It is not close.
And here's what makes me angriest of all: Corruption like this isn't just theft. It's the theft of opportunity itself. Because there is no equal opportunity if the game is rigged. When the powerful write the rules for themselves, working families don't get a fair shot — they get whatever scraps are left over after the well-connected have taken theirs.
That's exactly what Equal Opportunity Now was built to fight.
We know how to win. We've helped elect fighters who take on corruption, who champion honest government, who believe that public service means serving the public — not your own bank account. And we're building the bench of leaders who will do it up and down the ballot, in every corner of this country.
But we can't do it without you.
If you're in agreement that Washington corruption needs to stop, will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY TO DEFEAT MAGA! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
The game is rigged. Let's un-rig it.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder | Equal Opportunity Now

[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7980?t=14&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072526_vindman&akid=10013%2E5257348%2EzbD91M) Hi Derek, This is Lieutenant Colonel (Retired) Alex Vindman. Today is an important day, so I asked Adam Schiff if I could reach out. Exactly seven years ago today — on July 25, 2019 — I found myself at the heart of a constitutional crisis. I sat in the Situation Room and listened as Donald Trump asked Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to dig up dirt on his political rival ahead of the 2020 elections. **I blew the whistle on his corrupt phone call, an act that led to Trump’s first impeachment and ultimately cost me my military career.** People told me to keep my head down. But I took an oath to uphold and protect our Constitution when I joined the military — and it was my duty to report that call no matter the personal cost. I testified before Congress to stand up for our democracy. This led to the president unleashing a reign of intimidation, harassment, and retribution not just against my family and me, but against all of us. Today, our country is in crisis. We are entering a dark chapter of American history, one that echoes early stages of authoritarian power consolidation seen elsewhere. Ordinary citizens are getting attacked on the streets. The price of groceries and gas are sky-high. Health care premiums are through the roof. Meanwhile, my opponent is hand-picked by MAGA to be a rubber stamp for their radical agenda. Ashley Moody screwed Florida homeowners by caving to the big insurance companies, supported this administration that gutted disaster help for communities trying to rebuild, and had over a million dollars in her corporate stock traded last year while she had access to insider information only Congress gets. She’s not Florida’s senator. She’s theirs. I stepped up when our country needed a soldier. I stood up when someone had to say _no one’s above the law._ I am asking you to stand with me now. **[Trump may have ended my military service, but he will never shake my commitment to this country. This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0U2LpDAQBuBfE29KPtTowcMMTsPCzC77AXMMMSntgmgkFZ3tf7_00gt7nmtVUQ-87_ubebMYcFu-2hUGJDI-epOAIJ1wi0fyp5_ib4JsJJdtyXUpG2NdxhNMbQs_NFJ0c1fAIHTXcMHbVhbXoRa6VYK7DlzfaOnqFmrfawtedL7nvMDh_o9r2UgudC0qO0_11Ptu6qfezbJlNT92bzNUuBF6IBfjvseAGR1VMS1FGK4578TUE5MXJi-4zbG6YgjkbYAK_MHkZU4ApaMywAdS6a4JKaPdMN9Kf3qmLuSYGjmXUj1xzsWr6Mdv4_jyk8n2yKuheCQHTI17irSDy7gtj9UKHo-VqRFWi-ExdHbdLS4bU6Mj81c1_6vmrj5O45Zhy0yNz1-eX1_Md12-__pR_sulSIPfPzAEpFazmi93pXJxLfInijoH-ScAAP__rAujYA)

Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis is one of my favorite authors, full stop.

His writings were essential in deepening my faith in God and my understanding of the Bible. Maybe, since you opened my email, he has helped you, too.

Why are Lewis's words so powerful?

It's because he was a master at addressing life's most important questions. His vivid language is delightful and captivating to read.

Lewis's signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired so many skeptics to **become** believers and even more Christians to renew and deepen their faith. He is certainly the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

To help you learn more about Lewis's works related to Christianity, we produced a powerful, free course, "**C.S. Lewis on Christianity** ," which you can now own on DVD absolutely free.

**Claim your FREE DVD set of "C.S. Lewis on Christianity" using this secure link:**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/free-cs-lewis-christianity-dvd](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0U2LpDAQBuBfE29KPtTowcMMTsPCzC77AXMMMSntgmgkFZ3tf7_00gt7nmtVUQ-87_ubebMYcFu-2hUGJDI-epOAIJ1wi0fyp5_ib4JsJJdtyXUpG2NdxhNMbQs_NFJ0c1fAIHTXcMHbVhbXoRa6VYK7DlzfaOnqFmrfawtedL7nvMDh_o9r2UgudC0qO0_11Ptu6qfezbJlNT92bzNUuBF6IBfjvseAGR1VMS1FGK4578TUE5MXJi-4zbG6YgjkbYAK_MHkZU4ApaMywAdS6a4JKaPdMN9Kf3qmLuSYGjmXUj1xzsWr6Mdv4_jyk8n2yKuheCQHTI17irSDy7gtj9UKHo-VqRFWi-ExdHbdLS4bU6Mj81c1_6vmrj5O45Zhy0yNz1-eX1_Md12-__pR_sulSIPfPzAEpFazmi93pXJxLfInijoH-ScAAP__rAujYA)

In this course, you will study Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* Good and evil
* Conversion and faith
* Prayer and the Bible
* Suffering and death
* Heaven and Hell

The instructor, Michael Ward, is a distinguished visiting professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He wrote _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

You'll find this course especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith. You'll even trace Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for you to grow in your knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

[So please join us in studying Christianity with C.S. Lewis and Michael Ward with this beautiful free DVD set.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0U2LpDAQBuBfE29KPtTowcMMTsPCzC77AXMMMSntgmgkFZ3tf7_00gt7nmtVUQ-87_ubebMYcFu-2hUGJDI-epOAIJ1wi0fyp5_ib4JsJJdtyXUpG2NdxhNMbQs_NFJ0c1fAIHTXcMHbVhbXoRa6VYK7DlzfaOnqFmrfawtedL7nvMDh_o9r2UgudC0qO0_11Ptu6qfezbJlNT92bzNUuBF6IBfjvseAGR1VMS1FGK4578TUE5MXJi-4zbG6YgjkbYAK_MHkZU4ApaMywAdS6a4JKaPdMN9Kf3qmLuSYGjmXUj1xzsWr6Mdv4_jyk8n2yKuheCQHTI17irSDy7gtj9UKHo-VqRFWi-ExdHbdLS4bU6Mj81c1_6vmrj5O45Zhy0yNz1-eX1_Md12-__pR_sulSIPfPzAEpFazmi93pXJxLfInijoH-ScAAP__rAujYA)

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** You probably know that C.S. Lewis also wrote the children's series, _The Chronicles of Narnia_. My wife and I read those books to our children so many times! I can't tell you how many dog-eared copies we have of these.

One of the best parts of this course is learning how the Christian faith is woven into these captivating stories. **I hope you 'll take advantage of this great FREE DVD offer today:** [https://info.hillsdale.edu/free-cs-lewis-christianity-dvd](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0U2LpDAQBuBfE29KPtTowcMMTsPCzC77AXMMMSntgmgkFZ3tf7_00gt7nmtVUQ-87_ubebMYcFu-2hUGJDI-epOAIJ1wi0fyp5_ib4JsJJdtyXUpG2NdxhNMbQs_NFJ0c1fAIHTXcMHbVhbXoRa6VYK7DlzfaOnqFmrfawtedL7nvMDh_o9r2UgudC0qO0_11Ptu6qfezbJlNT92bzNUuBF6IBfjvseAGR1VMS1FGK4578TUE5MXJi-4zbG6YgjkbYAK_MHkZU4ApaMywAdS6a4JKaPdMN9Kf3qmLuSYGjmXUj1xzsWr6Mdv4_jyk8n2yKuheCQHTI17irSDy7gtj9UKHo-VqRFWi-ExdHbdLS4bU6Mj81c1_6vmrj5O45Zhy0yNz1-eX1_Md12-__pR_sulSIPfPzAEpFazmi93pXJxLfInijoH-ScAAP__rAujYA)

| | | Peter, A child who survived the earthquake in Venezuela may have lost everything else.Their parents. Their home. Every relative who might have taken them in. Now they have nowhere to sleep, nothing to eat, and no one left to protect them.**When a child has nowhere to turn, someone else will offer to take her somewhere.** **Too often, that someone is a trafficker, and they know exactly how to make the offer sound like help. **
---

They study the gaps left behind by disaster, and they move quickly, often faster than the systems built to protect children can respond. A shelter without enough staff. A registration process that hasn't caught up. A crowd of frightened families too overwhelmed to watch every child closely. These are the openings traffickers are trained to find.

My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film Sound of Freedom, and founded the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** because I believe, without reservation, that every child deserves to be safe, and **none of them are for sale.** Right now, we are working urgently with organizations on the ground in Venezuela. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RAND PAUL FOR U
body:
Dear Fellow Patriot,

Civil asset forfeiture allows the government to seize your cash, car, or property without first convicting you of a crime -- and sometimes without charging you at all.

_That is not how liberty is supposed to work._

America has just finished celebrating her 250th anniversary, and it’s crucial that we remember that freedom does not defend itself.

The Founders did not fight a Revolution so government could take property first and force citizens to fight for it later.

_That is why my FAIR Act matters._

**[And that’s why I need you to sign your petition right away to urge Congress to pass it.](http://track.randforkentucky.com/?xtl=1bnpuipkqno6bwtv31pl9hvbq54jk6bqo2qern4v2dst5id6t43hlei07n0mx3l1gjv69dk8hcb546ugjdtdtutwb4ihn5hysfmq2yl3pnb6294x52vewf9gveyb2jivp4oo3kild427l12r6o03uhe3nihmj27tg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tir1nq&__onlt=h)**

Please read my email below about why Congress must restore due process and protect Americans from unjust property seizures.

In Liberty,

Rand Paul

U.S. Senator (R-KY)

* * *

Dear Fellow Patriot,

Isn’t America supposed to be the land of the free?

That’s what I was always told. But right now, the federal government can take your cash, your car, or your property -- without ever charging you with a crime.

_That is not justice. That is legalized theft._

You might ask, “but Senator Paul, that would never happen in America, right?”

I wish I could say yes. Sadly, in over 30 states across America, the government can engage in what is called “civil asset forfeiture” – where the government can take your property without ever even charging you, let alone convicting you, of a crime! All the local police or sheriff need to do is claim the cash, or the car, or whatever was from a “criminal enterprise” and they take it ... and keep it!

I have been fighting against this abuse for years, but it still boggles my mind that this is happening in our republic.

_It’s wildly unconstitutional and an attack on the dignity of every American citizen._

Civil asset forfeiture has flipped the Fifth Amendment on its head.

Instead of “innocent until proven guilty,” it becomes “guilty until you can afford to fight back.”

And once the government takes your property, the burden is often on you to prove you deserve it.

_That is backwards in a free country._

That is why I have introduced S. 263, the Fifth Amendment Integrity Restoration (FAIR) Act.

**[Please click here to sign your petition right away urging Congress to pass the FAIR Act.](http://track.randforkentucky.com/?xtl=1bnpuipkqno6bwtv31pl9hvbq54jk6bqo2qern4v2dst5id6t43hlei07n0mx3l1gjv69dk8hcb546ugjdtdtutwb4ihn5hysfmq2yl3pnb6294x52vewf9gveyb2jivp4oo3kild427l12r6o03uhe3nihmj27tg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tir1nq&__onlt=h)**

This bill is about restoring basic constitutional order.

It makes it harder for the government to seize property from innocent people. It raises the government’s burden of proof, so they cannot take what is yours based on weak claims.

It also takes away a dangerous incentive by changing where forfeiture money goes, so agencies are not effectively “paid” when they seize property.

_That matters, because the incentives in civil asset forfeiture are upside-down._

Governments increase revenue through these unjust practices, which makes them hungry to take even more.

**[Please click here to sign your petition right away urging Congress to pass the FAIR Act.](http://track.randforkentucky.com/?xtl=1bnpuipkqno6bwtv31pl9hvbq54jk6bqo2qern4v2dst5id6t43hlei07n0mx3l1gjv69dk8hcb546ugjdtdtutwb4ihn5hysfmq2yl3pnb6294x52vewf9gveyb2jivp4oo3kild427l12r6o03uhe3nihmj27tg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tir1nq&__onlt=h)**

Common sense tells us that when a system rewards taking, you get more taking.

The FAIR Act is about drawing a bright line again.

If the government wants to punish someone, it should have to prove a crime in court.

If the government wants to take property, it should have to meet a high standard with real due process.

_And if the government is wrong, it should not be able to drag the case out until the person gives up._

Property rights are American rights.

The Fifth Amendment was written precisely because the Founders knew government power will expand unless citizens force it back into a constitutional box.

If you care about the Constitution, you should care about civil asset forfeiture reform.

_Because when the government can take property without a conviction, it spreads and it becomes routine._

The FAIR Act is a serious step toward stopping that abuse.

**[Please click here to sign your petition right away urging Congress to pass the FAIR Act.](http://track.randforkentucky.com/?xtl=1bnpuipkqno6bwtv31pl9hvbq54jk6bqo2qern4v2dst5id6t43hlei07n0mx3l1gjv69dk8hcb546ugjdtdtutwb4ihn5hysfmq2yl3pnb6294x52vewf9gveyb2jivp4oo3kild427l12r6o03uhe3nihmj27tg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tir1nq&__onlt=h)**

The government should never have the power to seize a person’s property without due process.

And the Fifth Amendment should mean what it says.

In Liberty,

Rand Paul

U.S. Senator (R-KY)

P.S. Americans are having their rights violated through civil asset forfeiture -- legalized theft at the hands of the government.

Under civil asset forfeiture, governments can take away your property if they simply suspect you of a crime. They don’t even need to charge you!

Peter,

**There's nothing wrong with being White.**

The anti-White and anti-Christian energy in America right now isn't even logical. When they're done silencing or persecuting all the White "conservatives", they'll just go after the White men on their own side. The ones who won't wear a dress or a leash first, then whenever or whoever else is convenient!

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. [ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Hey there, it's Josh Shapiro — with a quick story for you.

When I first ran for Governor back in 2022, my wife, Lori, would put her
finger to my chest and tell me “You better win” every morning on my way
out of the house.

And Derek, she’s
not the only one. Every family, every child, every teacher, and every
worker is counting on this campaign right now. They’ve placed their faith
in all of us to protect their freedoms, invest in their futures, and win
this enormously important election on November 3rd.

It’s on us to make them proud on Election Day — because so much is on the
line. [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/5001?t=1001&akid=155%2E245147%2ESvZCDz ]Please, will you chip in today to power our campaign throughout
this uncertain, historic election year?

We cannot become complacent,
Derek. Less than two years ago,
Trump won Pennsylvania. It was a painful, disappointing night for so many
of us. Now, I’m determined to make sure history doesn’t repeat itself.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/5001?t=1002&akid=155%2E245147%2ESvZCDz ]Derek, there
is no donation too small for our campaign. Because in a state like
Pennsylvania, every dime could be the difference between victory and
defeat. With all that said, can I count on your support? Our campaign is
getting ready to make some tough finance decisions, so we want to raise as
much grassroots money as possible in the next 24 hours.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your

Josh Shapiro

subject: It was AIPAC all along
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Remember when a bunch of vaguely-named super PACs popped out of nowhere
and started spending millions of dollars against our progressive primary
candidates across the country this year? And do you remember when we said
AIPAC was behind it?

Well, we were right.

FEC reports now prove that AIPAC’s super PAC (United Democracy Project)
secretly funneled $900,000 to BOLD America and $1.3 million to Elect
Democratic Women (EDW) Action Fund in the middle of the primaries,
unbeknownst to voters at the time.

BOLD America spent at least $2.5 million in the race against Darializa
Avila Chevalier in New York, while EDW shifted $2.4 million to yet another
shell PAC, Pro Choice Majority Action, which then spent $1.5 million
against Melat Kiros in Denver.

And in Claire Valdez’s race, her so-called progressive opponent was
propped up by a group called Progressive Unity Fund, which received
hundreds of thousands of dollars from another pro-Israel lobby group,
NORPAC.

All of this cements the fact that AIPAC and the pro-Israel lobby are toxic
to Democratic voters, and they know it — so they now have to hide their
spending and support for candidates who do their bidding.

But despite their millions of dollars from Trump-supporting megadonors,
they still lost all three of these primaries thanks to the power of our
grassroots movement.

Now AIPAC and their donors are spending millions against our next two
primary challengers, Cori Bush and Donavan McKinney, because they’re
committed to ending all taxpayer funding for Israel’s genocide.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260725-2.GiVSWV&refcode=em20260725-38084&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=38084%2E1203867%2EdGBqfo ]With your help, we can defeat the pro-Israel lobby and their dark money

running out, so pitch in $5 or whatever you can spare to
help us win!

Justice Democrats

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-jackson?refcode=260720_eon_jacksonsplit&amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-jackson?refcode=260720_eon_jacksonsplit&amount=25]
Mainers have spoken: I am incredibly proud to be their choice for Democratic nominee in our U.S. Senate race.
My name is Troy Jackson. Growing up in Allagash, I didn’t think I’d ever be anything other than a fifth-generation logger. And for a long time, that was more than enough.
But then I got a political education. Not in some Ivy League university — when I was working in the North Woods, grinding out 80-hour workweeks under the thumb of a billionaire. In those woods I discovered the truth: working class people in this country aren’t struggling to get by because we’re not trying hard enough, or not smart enough, or not anything enough. We’re getting crushed by a rigged system, and we have been for way too long.
I got into politics after a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages.
I stayed because once I was there, it was clear that nobody in power understood the actual hardships I’d been living my whole life. Working class people deserve to have someone who lives these struggles in rooms where decisions are being made.
Since then I’ve fought to lower the cost of prescription drugs, pass universal school meals, expand rural healthcare, protect abortion rights, and deliver tax relief. And we’ve won a lot of those fights. But there’s always been someone with more power stepping in to water down or block our progress, or dictate just how far we could go. That’s what happens when our politicians can be bought by corporations and billionaires.
So now it’s time to take this fight to Washington.
Susan Collins is the most vulnerable GOP senator — and for good reason. Her voting record is a disaster. Mainers just can’t trust her to look out for our best interests.
I’m ready to win this, but I’m gonna need you by my side. Will you split a donation of any amount between my campaign and Equal Opportunity Now so we can get ready to win big in November and keep this movement going?
